thread:
mike: Heads-up — similarity lane (embeddings/rerank) in us-west-2 is starting to saturate; we're seeing bursts of 429s and backlog. Noticed after the morning batch of index updates.
anya: Any graphs or raw numbers? which queues are full?
mike: CPU on the routing control-plane is fine, but GPU pool util ~98% and queue length at the lane head is spiking. paste of `qstat`:
```
lane: similarity-rerank-usw2
active_gpus: 24/24
pending_reqs: 1347
avg_latency_p90: 420ms
prefix-cache-hit: 12%
```
luca: :thinking_face: That prefix-cache-hit is low — forced cold-starts for a lot of rerank requests. Are we getting a lot of long-sequence inputs?
mike: Yes, multi-sentence queries from search partner. Also saw a config change earlier today that reduced per-lane reserved capacity for rerank to free up space for text-gen. Not sure who changed it.
ops-bot: alert: lane_throttle_triggered similarity-rerank-usw2 count=3 window=5m severity=warning
sasha: I'm oncall — rolling investigation. If we can't scale identical GPUs immediately we should put a temporary admission control rule (soft 429) at the front with informative retry-after and increase model degradation fallback.
anya: +1. Propose: 1) enable per-tenant soft throttle 2) move low-SLA customers to the inexpensive similarity-light model 3) bump dedicated nodes by +4 until evening. Cost note: ~+$3k/day for the extra GPUs.
luca: Implementation detail: we can flip a config flag in the router to divert 20% of traffic to similarity-light; that's realtime. For admission control I can push `rate_limit_per_lane=0.75` (was 1.0).
mike: Patch looks safe. I'll open a short-lived canary to route 10% first.
deploy-bot: deploy started: router-config v2026.03.18-7 -> canary (10%)
anya: Also turning on prefix caching for rerank for the top 5000 query prefixes (temporary) — should help hit-rate.
sasha: Please add a HUD alert to the console for token cost + latency per-customer so customers on rerank see degraded SLA.
luca: Quick command I ran on the node group shows many small batches causing overhead:
```
kubectl exec -it router-0 -- curl localhost:9000/metrics | grep batch_size
batch_size_avg{lane="similarity-rerank"} 1.8
```
mike: so combining the two fixes (increase batch target, prefix cache warm) should drop p90 by ~30% and lower GPU pressure.
anya: Action items: 1) mike -> start canary and request +4 nodes (in progress) 2) luca -> push rate_limit_per_lane=0.75 and divert 20% if canary ok 3) sasha -> notify customers and add console HUD 4) ops-bot -> keep throttling alert open.
ops-bot: ticket created: INF-9421 "similarity lane saturation — us-west-2" assigned to eng-infra
mike: Will monitor dashboards; will update in 20m. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
